desc: Derive and verify the characterization f(L,R) = distinct(L,R) − adjpairs(L,R); validated via BFS brute force on 200 random tiny arrays.
Implement sum over subarrays of distinct count in O(N) via last-occurrence contributions.
Implement per-value-pair count of subarrays containing both v and v+1 via inclusion–exclusion with gap decomposition.
Replace `sorted(pv + pw)` with an O(len) two-pointer merge of the two already-sorted occurrence lists to guarantee O(N) total time.
Verify answer on samples (16, 23) by hand and edge cases (N=1, all equal, all distinct, consecutive 1..N); Python ints are unbounded and fast I/O is used.
Finalize solution: brute-force self-test removed; final code reads stdin and writes the single answer.
